summary: @servicetitan/widget-platform-monolith preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from a GitHub releases URL into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against the bundled 727 KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled CJS artifact (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with string-array rotation and hex-indexed lookup obfuscation, not human-readable source. Running an alternate language runtime against a large opaque compiled artifact at install time is inconsistent with the package's declared purpose (a small React widget-platform stub), and any behavior the payload performs (credential theft, exfiltration, backdoor) executes on the installer's machine before any code review is possible. The package is published under the corporate `@servicetitan/*` scope while the tarball contents and CHANGELOG (which credits the personal GitHub account `karpoff-titan`) do not match a normal first-party ServiceTitan release, consistent with a dependency-confusion vehicle targeting internal build systems.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
